description: Somalia Dot Grid (2014) is a data set listed in SODMA open data portal (Somalia and Greater Horn of Africa disaster risk data), a disaster risk data portal, published or maintained by SWALIM. The Dot Grid was produced by applying the USGS Rapid Land Cover Mapper (RLCM) methodology that uses regularly spaced (in this case 500m spacing) dot grid statistical approach to generate land cover data. The principal aim was to produce an updated statistical assessment of Somalia's cultivable area. Coverage: Somalia. The portal files it under the publisher SWALIM. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, PNG. The portal shows 2025-06-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sodma-somalia-disaster-risk-data-portal.
